additional_info.subject: RE: 0398750 - ID0398750-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R2 170001525] DC1 is changing its states from A-->E CRM:02023000410
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. I have analyzed the charger for the last month and observed the DC1 outlet state fluctuation that happened on 07.01.2025. I am suspecting there is an internal issue from EcoG or ecog-secc-adapter (container) that caused this one, and thereafter this was not repeated. Please find the below details for your reference.
Occurrence for last one month : 371 Times
Occurrence on  07/01/2025 : 343 ( 92.45 % ) - Started on : 2025-01-07 06:39:50.433 And lasted till : ,2025-01-07 07:39:26.958 ( 1 Hr )
Conclusion: Found abnormality persisted only for one day & there after it worked normally.
The recent pilot state changes are due to
SECC: no comm for 750ms ""DC1"
or
Error polling coap://10.20.17.101:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s
& in very low rate as negligible.
Please feel free to discuss with me in case of any queries.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
